name: draft_from_description
description: Generate a fully-structured Indonesian perjanjian draft from a natural-language description. No template required.

function.name: draft_from_description
function.description: Compose a tailored perjanjian from a natural-language brief.

description.description: Free-form description of what the document should cover.

name: draft_revise_section
description: Propose a rewrite of an existing document range. Returns Suggestion rows the user accepts/rejects.

function.name: draft_revise_section
function.description: Propose a track-changes rewrite scoped to a range.

instruction.description: What to change, e.g. 'buat pasal pengakhiran lebih ketat'.

name: draft_insert_clause
description: Generate a new clause (force_majeure / data_protection / non_solicitation / free-form) that fits the existing draft's tone, and propose its insertion as a Suggestion.

function.name: draft_insert_clause
function.description: Generate a new clause and queue it as an insert-style Suggestion.

clause_type.description: Slug like 'force_majeure' or a free-form description.

after_section.description: Insert after this Pasal/Section title; omit for end-of-doc.
